title: Strong Markov coding for fixed-point-free Hölder metric Anosov flows with regular pre-Markov families at arbitrarily small scales
source_title: Strong symbolic dynamics for geodesic flows on CAT$(-1)$ spaces and other metric Anosov flows
author: David Constantine; Jean-François Lafont; Daniel J. Thompson
difficulty_reason: Metric hyperbolic orbit tracking is transferred through Hölder flow-box projections to exponential control of the symbolic coding map. Refinement of pre-Markov rectangles preserves return-time regularity, yielding a Hölder suspension roof and finite-to-one equivariant coding beyond smooth Anosov manifolds.
